title: Most people use AI to get answers. Power users use AI to get work done.
description:
The real breakthrough isn't asking better questions. It's creating systems where AI can research, organize information, follow instructions, and complete repetitive tasks with minimal supervision.

When you connect your tools, files, and workflows, AI stops acting like a chatbot and starts acting like a digital employee.

The biggest productivity gains won't come from writing one perfect prompt.

They'll come from automating the tasks you do every week.

This is Day 3 of becoming an AI power user.

If you could automate one part of your work today, what would it be?
